name: The Golf Club at Fossil Creek
_comment_tees: Scorecard from GolfPass (2924); its pars match OpenStreetMap's hole tags. Ratings matched to tees by total yards (Palmer = Black 6865, Tournament = Blue 6457, Club = White 6006). Men's ratings, but Forward is rated for women only.
_comment_drop: Polygons containing these points are not part of the course: the practice green by the clubhouse, a bunker on grass, the fairway round a chipping green no hole plays to and a fairway sliver by the water.
_comment_shift: OSM outlines sit this many metres off the Esri imagery; every point is moved by it.
